source.verification: Public logged-out Bugzilla page inspected in the browser. No runtime tests or remote CI were run.

text:
Bug 1876261 reports NNTP messages remaining blank after a network failure until Thunderbird restarts. Comment 8 identifies an uninvalidated message cache entry and missing response timeout. A timeout eventually invalidated the entry, but early fixes did not handle selecting another message before the timeout. Comments 13 and 18 refine the recovery and reproduction order: disable offline storage, connect successfully, interrupt incoming packets, select the message, then go offline; restore connectivity and return online. Going offline before the failed fetch can avoid the bug. No firewall command was executed by this study.

Comment 9 also reports stale error pages replacing a later message. Comment 16 rejects a proposed popup in favor of a less disruptive error page, with obsolete actions discarded when selection changes. This discussion does not establish that this landing fixed every stale error page or Retry-button problem. Comment 18 treats Retry as a separate issue. Comment 24 confirms a message can be retrieved after the network failure, and confirms that going offline must occur after selecting it. The linked landing is e6176dd4d306. Later beta uplift approval is historical context, not a new CI result.

Exact short excerpts:
Comment 8: "the cache entry for the message that fails to display is never invalidated"
Comment 9: "Error page should be cancelled when user selects another message."
Comment 16: "any actions for the previous message should get disregarded."
Comment 24: "It is possible to retrieve a message after a network failure. Thanks."

title: Bug 1876261: NNTP failed-fetch recovery and reproduction order
